title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person violating section 379A-1 shall be fined not more than $200 or imprisoned not more than six months, or both.
crossReferences: Classification of offense and authorized punishment, see §§701-107, 706-640, and 706-663.

bodyHtml:
[§379A-2]  Penalty.  Any person violating section 379A-1 shall be fined not more than $200 or imprisoned not more than six months, or both. [L Sp 1949, c 8, §3; RL 1955, §300-3; HRS §757-2; ren L 1972, c 9, pt of §1]
